metadata.schedule_summary: Cisplatin is planned on Day 1. Etoposide is planned on Days 1–3: usually all three days by infusion, or a prescribed alternative with an infusion on Day 1 and capsules twice daily on Days 2–3. The source plans 4–6 cycles, usually every 21 days. The team may delay, reduce or stop treatment according to your health and response.
